reference.title: Fix daemon LFS upload gap and backfill test coverage
reference.summary: Fixed two related bugs in the session recording pipeline and then did a broad coverage sweep over the areas where they hid. First bug: the daemon's anti-entropy finalization committed session files as plain git blobs instead of uploading to LFS (a known TODO). Second bug: the LFS upload pipeline never verified objects with the server after PUT. Fixed both by extracting shared upload logic into internal/lfs and wiring the daemon's ProcessResult to write meta.json and upload to LFS before committing, and by implementing the LFS verify action with proper error handling. A follow-up coverage audit identified P0/P1/P2 gaps across PushWithRetry, daemon sync discovery, auth token concurrency, findGitRootFrom, and session push-summary; every gap got new tests. Shipped as PR #301.
key_actions: Extracted shared LFS upload logic from the CLI into internal/lfs for daemon reuse
Modified daemon ProcessResult to write meta.json and upload to LFS before commit
Implemented the LFS verify action (POST to verify href after upload)
Audited coverage across 6 packages and bucketed gaps into P0/P1/P2
Wrote tests for PushWithRetry LFS detection, auto-resolve, and rebase guard
Added daemon sync discovery, auth token concurrency, findGitRootFrom, and push-summary tests
